provenance.named_rule: keep a way when its highway value is in the accepted list and its name is non-null and non-blank; every kept way is promoted to MultiLineString after the clip drops clip-tangent point fragments

aggregates.highway: semicolon-joined unique values in first-seen order over ways sorted numerically by osm_id
aggregates.n_ways: count of ways grouped under the name
aggregates.n_parts: geometry part count after the union
aggregates.length_m: ST_Length of the merged geometry, rounded to 0.1 m

provenance.note_checksums_are_informational: GeoPackage verification is content-based, not byte-based: GDAL writes a last_change timestamp into gpkg_contents on every save, so the sha256 below changes on every rebuild even when the data is identical. The acceptance path is content comparison via scripts/verify_data.py trails; these digests describe the files as currently committed.
